description: Browse the directory without a search text, filtered by category, tag, listing type and/or pricing type, sorted like the site listing (newest first by default). Paginated: pass the returned `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page.

category.description: Optional category filter: slug, key or numeric id as returned by list_categories.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result (`next_cursor`).

locale.description: Language of names, descriptions and URLs (site locale code). Default: en.

pricing.description: Optional pricing filter. Valid keys: free, freemium, one-time, open-source, credits-pay-per-use, subscription, custom-enterprise. Synonyms: "free" matches free AND freemium tools (a usable free tier); "paid" matches every non-free model; "open source" works too. Several values may be comma-separated (e.g. "free,open-source"). Full list with counts: list_pricing_types.

tag.description: Optional tag filter: slug, key or numeric id as returned by list_tags.

type.description: Optional listing type filter: slug, key or numeric id as returned by list_types.

name: list_tools
title: Browse AI tools
